mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate reduces the cost of capital for corporations, increasing the present value of future equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeding 3.5% triggers a central bank tightening response, increasing real interest rates and compressing equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% (YoY).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is rising (FEDFUNDS increasing) and the unemployment rate is below 4.0% (UNRATE < 4.0%), the combination signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle that reduces corporate profit margins and equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE < 4.0%, S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0%), the S&P 500 exhibits positive forward returns as the Federal Reserve implements accommodative monetary policy to stimulate the economy, with the effect being most pronounced over a 60-day horizon.
failure_condition: In periods when UNRATE > 5.0%, S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A higher housing starts rate (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand and economic activity, leading to higher corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is above its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1,200,000 units (HOUST < 1200), it signals a weakening housing market and reduced consumer spending, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 1200, S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts are rising (HOUST increasing) and industrial production is declining (INDPRO decreasing), the combination indicates a demand surge without sufficient supply capacity, leading to inflationary pressures and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST increases and INDPRO decreases, S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a low industrial production regime (INDPRO < 95.0), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns as the economy faces supply constraints that reduce corporate profitability and increase inflation, with the effect most pronounced over a 20-day horizon.
failure_condition: In periods when INDPRO < 95.0, S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances.
